placements.title: Stated calibration becomes verified calibration
placements.frame: What was checked against a reference, and across what range, before a calibration was treated as settled rather than merely stated?
placements.why: The position holds Quill Ashgrove's claim that the Kestrelwood spectrograph is calibrated at 88.4 MHz and holds across the observing band, backed by a stated verification against the June reference plates. The theme, that a calibration claim gains weight through a named check against a reference over a stated range, is one future envelopes about instrument calibration will keep feeding. It is not a restatement of the single fact. No existing leaf was supplied, so this is a standalone mint with no lineage.
